content.heading: Definition of State; laws inconsistent with Fundamental Rights
content.text: For Part III, the State includes the Government and Parliament of India, the Government and the Legislature of each of the States, and all local or other authorities within the territory of India or under the control of the Government of India (Article 12). Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of Fundamental Rights are void to the extent of the inconsistency; the State shall not make any law that takes away or abridges rights conferred by Part III (Article 13). Prefer provision:india:constitution-art-12 and provision:india:constitution-art-13 for clause-level text.
